caption:
Trainer Toto demos exercises all day. Clients get looked after, but Toto's own calves and shoulders keep tightening up.

Remedial massage can help muscles feel easier, but it complements rest, sleep and sensible load planning rather than replacing them. Recovery usually goes better when they work together.

Hybi's PT recovery: demo only as much as needed, calf and forearm stretch 20 seconds × 2 between sessions, and keep one lighter day each week.

Pain that wakes you at night, swelling or numbness are worth an assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
